title.name: ShareMount
title.sub: Keeps SMB shares mounted and brings them back after sleep, network changes and NAS restarts. With the passwords macOS already keeps for the Finder.

new.title: Only your own mounts
new.text: With fast user switching, every signed-in user runs their own ShareMount and only sees the shares they mounted themselves. Other users' mounts are never shown as yours or disconnected.

new.title: Updates from any account
new.text: If the app belongs to another user, macOS asks for an administrator password and the app keeps its owner. After an update ShareMount restarts by itself for the others, mounts stay connected.

new.title: Calendar versions
new.text: Year, month and the release of that month: 26.10.4 is the fourth release of October 2026. The jump from 2.5 is intended, the update check finds it as usual.

new.title: Glass buttons
new.text: On macOS 26 and 27 the install and notice buttons use the Liquid Glass style, and the menu rows follow the window corners.

features.title: Reconnects on its own
features.text: Checks at launch, after wake, on every network change and once a minute. Lost shares come back with a growing back-off from 30 seconds to 15 minutes.

features.title: No more beachballs
features.text: A share counts as dead only if the server stops answering on port 445 or reading the folder hangs twice in a row. Right after wake nothing is unmounted.

features.title: Uses the macOS keychain
features.text: Mounts through macOS (NetFS and NetAuth), which takes the password from the entry the Finder creates. The app never reads or stores your passwords.

features.title: Clean paths
features.text: Keeps shares at /Volumes/<name> instead of <name>-1, so scripts and backups always find them, and tells you if a leftover folder is in the way.

features.title: Gentle with your NAS
features.text: If a server rejects the login, ShareMount stops retrying until you sign in again, so your NAS account is not locked out.

features.title: All your Macs
features.text: With iCloud Drive the list of shares (not the passwords) is shared between your Macs. Passwords stay in each Mac's keychain.

features.title: Native menu
features.text: Designed like the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth menus of macOS 26 and 27, with free space per share, connection time and one click to open, disconnect or reconnect.

features.title: Easy setup
features.text: Add shares by hand, pick a server found via Bonjour, paste an smb:// address, or adopt shares already mounted in the Finder.

items.title: Port 445
items.text: A quick check on the SMB port tells whether a server is reachable at all.

items.title: 10 seconds
items.text: If reading a folder takes longer than that, twice in a row, the mount counts as hung.

items.title: 0 passwords
items.text: ShareMount mounts through macOS, which takes them from the keychain.
